routes.name: the role screen’s work-order permissions
routes.ui_path: “Settings” → “Roles & Permissions” in the sidebar → the pencil on a role → the “Work order lines” section (column “Create & Edit”), and the “Work orders” section with the “View mode” block beneath it → “Save”
routes.note: “Work Order Line - Create and Edit” and “Work Orders → Work Order View Mode” DO NOT EXIST. 117 and 90 cases respectively named them.

routes.name: print a credit note (credit memo)
routes.ui_path: top menu “Customers” → open the customer → the “Invoices” tab (label carries a count) → the row whose “Type” chip reads “Credit” and whose “No.” begins “CM” → in the “Action” column, the printer icon (hover tooltip “Print credit memo”)
routes.note: The 2026-08-31 pass tried 13 API shapes including /api/credit-memos/{id} and concluded the document was "not rendered on this branch". It IS - the route is a /pdf SUFFIX and it is a DOWNLOAD, not a preview. The Action column also offers “Cash Out” and “Reverse”. The tooltip is a hover-only Quasar q-tooltip, absent from the DOM until hovered, so searching title/aria-label finds nothing. And the Type cell textContent is lowercase "credit" - the capitalised "Credit" a tester sees comes from CSS text-transform.

routes.name: the work order audit history
routes.ui_path: open a work order → the three-dots button at the top right, between “SHOPCOACH ANALYSIS” and “New Line” → “Audit Log”
routes.note: The menu item is “Audit Log” but the window it opens is titled “Work Order Log” - different names. The event text is “Work order printed”; “Work order printed history” never existed (a clock icon's own text glued on by a tr.innerText read).
